verdict.rationale: AI Gateway provides granular per-request controls to opt out of logging/telemetry, e.g. the `cf-aig-collect-log` header to bypass default logging and `cf-aig-collect-log-payload` to avoid storing raw prompt/response data, letting users retain metrics visibility without persisting sensitive content. However, there's no evidence of a global 'opt out of all tracking' toggle—usage metrics (tokens, cost, requests) appear to be collected by default for billing/observability regardless of these headers.
